Tactics

THE OPTIONS OF THE DAY : NOTHING FROM THE FUTURE

FORMATION

Herbert Chapman's WM system has been standard at the biggest clubs since the late 1920s. Plenty of smaller sides still play the older Pyramid. Which will you trust?

STYLE OF PLAY

Not everyone playing the same shape played it alike.

APPROACH

How should the side set about the game?

CHOOSE YOUR SETUP ABOVE. IT TAKES EFFECT FROM THE NEXT MATCH.

STUDY TRIP ABROAD
MARK HIM CLOSELY

A matchday instruction, not a training one : tell the side to shadow the opposition's danger man out of the game. It only actually works if the week's TRAINING has been spent on him first (see the Training tab) : without that groundwork, the lads don't know who they're supposed to be watching, and pulling a man out of his normal game for nothing does more harm than good.

AN APPROACH FROM ANOTHER CLUB

OPEN MANAGERIAL VACANCIES

A club with a vacancy here hasn't appointed anyone yet. You can put yourself forward for any you fancy, though the board there will only take it seriously if your own record gives them reason to.

THE FOOTBALL ASSOCIATION

With Walter Winterbottom standing down after England's World Cup campaign, the Football Association have asked to speak to you about taking the England job. There has never been an opening like it before, and there may not be again.

INCOMING OFFERS FOR OUR PLAYERS

CONTRACTS

Every man here is on a one-season deal, same as every professional in the country : the club decides whether to keep him each close season, and under the retain-and-transfer system now in force, a man the club chooses to retain cannot simply walk to another League club, contract or no contract, wages or no wages. It is a one-sided arrangement, and this is deliberately not softened.

Internationals

FOLLOWED FROM THE PRESS

PICK THE ENGLAND TEAM

As England manager you can call up any eligible, available English player ANYWHERE in the English game -- every First, Second, Third and Fourth Division club genuinely holds its own real, individually named, individually attributed squad (see the v197 changelog entry), not just your own books. Tick up to 11 men below (real names, real positions, real CA) -- any shirt you don't fill plays at the standard estimate for the rest of the England pool. HONEST LIMIT: only YOUR OWN squad's injuries/suspensions/call-ups are tracked player-by-player, so a man at another club always shows as available here even if that club's news says otherwise -- this game only tracks a club-level injury aggregate for anyone else's squad, not a per-player one (see aiClubInjuryCA). Southern/Isthmian League (non-league) players are NOT included -- those two competitions are only ever simulated as abstract strength numbers, with no named squads behind them at all. Who you pick genuinely changes how England play.
